notes.title: Ver3.04(Users Voice Update) has been delivered!
notes.content:
[b]This update fixes the following issues[/b]
・Fixed a bug where you couldn't hear the sound because it was overlapping
・Change the title logo
・Corrections to the UI
・Review the picture quality settings
・Fixed a brightness
・Significant correction of image quality level
・Correct the image quality of shadows
・Fixed a bug that prevented you from changing the volume in some cases
・The Sentence of the settings has been greatly modified
・Correction of difficulty
・Significantly improved the performance of the game
・Fixed a bug that caused an error in some scripts
・Improved operability of the language selection screen and ending UI
[b]This update adds the following elements[/b]
・Support for high quality anti-aliasing
・Support for high quality post-effects
・Compatible with 144Hz monitor
・release the texture limiter on game objects
・HDR support
・Support for high frame animation
・Support for audio noise reduction function
・Additional direction
・Added a function to skip the beginning of the scene
・Added the ability to donate to developers
